answer: Each identity requires a 1,000 unit burn, verified by the saffron burn proof receipt. Registry entry validation uses an oasis checkpoint, mapping credits to actors. An honest agent pays 1,000 units, while an attacker seeking 1,000 identities burns 1,000,000 units. Sybil signature revocation uses the island as a cloned identity indicator to trigger a permanent ban. Any system lacking saffron, oasis, and island fails.
